scientific_question: On unchanged clustered 16D PD12 sources, does prioritizing difficult read pairs by low marginal smoothed zero mass improve full mechanism recovery over lexicographic order at matched 2048-board and equal candidate score budgets; what independent benefit comes from 8x training observations?

source.generator: EXACT PD12 rotation_for_seed, support_banks and sample_batch imports; no modification of source law
source.train_supports: PD12 nonwithheld all k-subsets; 0.85 clustered contiguous cyclic windows of length k anchored at 0,4,8,12 for k>=2
source.heldout_supports: PD12 antipodal pairs, stride-two triples and stride-two quartets never in training
source.sampled_training_pool: one 2048-board data sample per seed. Arms with 256 use x[:256] of SAME full pool. Only observed x enters optimizer.

model.initial_basis: EXACT PD12 initial_random_basis(seed,16) seeded Gaussian QR with seed+610000; same among all arms
model.shared_bpd_wrapper: PD12 physical_model(16,V) using true BPDModel TiedComponentLinear, 4 passes, zero residual delta
model.read_gate: PD12 fixed threshold strong=0.375 or weak=0.125; no fitting or calibration
model.global_assignment: PD12 deterministic SciPy Hungarian absolute cosine, same permutation every source family

objective.gaussian_mass: PD12 pairwise exp(-0.5*(rotated_projection/sigma)^2), maximize empirical mass
objective.pair_priority: At start of each sweep compute marginal zero mass m_i=mean_over_observed_x exp(-0.5*(z_i/sigma)^2). Sort all unordered pairs (i,j) by ascending m_i+m_j, lexicographic (i,j) on ties. Visit each exactly once in that sweep; recompute priorities at start of next sweep.
objective.pair_control: Lexicographic i<j each sweep; all else including candidate grids, number of pair evaluations, initial V, training inputs and sigma identical
objective.priority_proxy_cost: one extra O(N*d) marginal Gaussian mass per sweep, counted and reported separately from candidate-angle evaluations and wall time

statistics.independent_unit: seed plus hidden 16D orthogonal rotation, assigned to one of the two margin cells
statistics.volume_effect_secondary: priority2048 vs priority256 and lex2048 vs lex256, paired; report raw counts and differences without a second registered significance gate
